purpose: Create a small, honest set of gameplay moments that makes a child or grown-up want to understand and try Mythical Void.

currentVisualFinding.source: Kevin's direct testing feedback and a fresh full-size review of the current public capture set
currentVisualFinding.finding: The source-changed production capture still fails the public visual bar. The village is crowded with overlapping structures, rings, lines and text; the movement route is empty and dark; the phone frame has a black side strip; and the desktop video did not meet the minimum duration or frame count.
currentVisualFinding.decision: Keep the entire media set withdrawn. Reject the 03:15 private run before adult or Kevin review; no exact asset, wording or channel is approval-ready.

requiredMoments.publicQuestion: What can my creature and I do together?
requiredMoments.shot: The creature visibly helps the player solve or survive one clear obstacle.
mustShow: player and creature in the same frame
requiredMoments.reason: The message box, map-like settlement layers and thin effects compete with the creature. A new player cannot see one clear problem, action and result.

requiredMoments.shot: One readable choice followed by a visible change in the world.
mustShow: the changed place, creature or relationship
requiredMoments.reason: The choice words are readable, but the after state is mainly thin lines, tiny sprouts and a recap box. The world change is not obvious without copy.

requiredMoments.publicQuestion: What is surprising about this universe?
requiredMoments.shot: The player and creature discover one memorable feature of an alien realm.
mustShow: player and creature in the same frame
a composition understandable without a caption
requiredMoments.reason: The memory effect looks like targeting lines and transparent duplicates inside the same crowded village scene. No impossible alien discovery reads clearly.

requiredMoments.publicQuestion: Does this feel alive when it moves?
requiredMoments.shot: A short uninterrupted stretch of play with the creature continuously present.
mustShow: no menu takeover or dead time
every frame watched at desktop and phone presentation size
requiredMoments.reason: The phone clip has a black side strip and both clips show small figures sliding across an empty dark route. The desktop capture also stopped below the duration and frame minimum.

automationMay: capture candidates into the private review area
check dimensions, missing files and known withdrawn paths
automationMayNot: describe a story screen or marketing illustration as gameplay

moments.title: THE CREATURE HELPS
moments.purpose: A nine-year-old can point to the frame and explain what the creature did and what changed.
moments.plainLanguageBeat: Nova maps food paths that regrow. The Sanctuary gains 5 happiness.

moments.title: A CHOICE CHANGES SOMETHING
moments.purpose: The visible world response carries more weight than the choice menu.
moments.plainLanguageBeat: Clear the current first. The current moves again and a living route opens through the Sanctuary.

moments.title: A STRANGE DISCOVERY
moments.purpose: The frame could only belong to Mythical Void while still reading as playable game space.
moments.plainLanguageBeat: The Village Heart remembers a choice as a visible current woven into the terrain.

moments.title: MOVEMENT FEELS ALIVE
moments.purpose: A short continuous capture proves ordinary play without edits rescuing the result.
moments.plainLanguageBeat: Nova and the astronaut travel together through the living forest.
